main_text.l: Rusticari] Rurari, Varr. Rurare, Plaut. Rure morari, Mart. Villicari, Pompon. Ligone philosophari.
Rustice] Rusticius, Hor. Rusticatim tanquam, quæ urbanatim nescio, Pompon.
Rusticitas, sumitur etiam pro rusticis & Agrestibus, vid. Ruditas morum.
Rusticus, nom.] Rusticanus quidam. Rusticulus non incatuus, Cic. Ruricola, Col. Custos simplicitatis. Homo de plebe.
Rutilare] Rutilare, rufare capillum, Plin. Irrufare capillum, Hieron. vid. Nitere.

Rutilus] Rutilatus crinis, Tac. Subrutilus, Plin. Aureus color barbæ, Ovid. Auro certans, Sil. Flammeus, Cic. Flammeolus, Col. Croceus ignis, Claud. Igneus color, Plin. Flammis florens, Lucr. Florus, Næv. Russus, Lucr. Russeolæ fasciæ, Capitol.
Sabbathum] Sabbatum. Sabbata, plus tantum volunt, Plin. Ovid. Lambin. Cultaque Judæo Septima sacra viro, Ovid. Ignava lux, Juv. Dies Saturni, Tibull.
Sabbatarius, vid. Judæus. Sabulum, vid. Arena.
Saburrare] Saburrâ gravare onerariam, Liv. Onerare navem frumento. In onerariam navem aliqua conjicere, Cic. Corbitare, Plaut.
Saccharum] Mel concretum. Sal Indicus, Gor. Mel arundinum, ex Græ.
Sacellum] Sacrarium Cereris, Cic. Lararium, Lampr. Ædicula, Liv. Augurale, Tac. Auguratorium, Lips. Fanulum, Fest. Ædis sacræ appendix.

Sacer] Magno ritu sacer. Sacratissimus, Plin. Sacratus, Ovid. Sanctus campus; Religiosus locus: altaria religiosissima, Cic. Sanctior, Id. Sacratior, Plin. Sacrosanctus, Val. Max. Augustus locus, Cic.
Sacerdos] Sacerdotio præditus, Cic. Sacricola, Tac. Sacrificulus, Liv. Mysta, Sen. Victimarius, Plin. Cultrarius, Suet. Presbyter Christiani ritûs, Amm. Presbyter Christiana-

page.notes: The final line reads "Presbyter Chri-" with "ftia-" at the line end; the last word is a hyphenated line-end and is transcribed as printed. Rendering of "Christiani" at line end is uncertain.
